---
title: "BME364: 02 MTT viability"
subtitle: "OD540 → blank → % of control → ANOVA + Dunnett → IC50"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Run every chunk from the project folder (two levels up from R/windows/), where data/ is
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../..")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, fig.width = 6.4, fig.height = 4.2)
```

**Data:** `data/mtt_raw.csv`, one 96-well plate of Caco-2 cells, 48 h P80 at 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125,
0.0625 and 0.03125 % v/v (2-fold dilutions, 1:32) in columns 3–8. The vehicle control (0 %) is in
columns 2 **and** 9, on both sides of the series, and the blank (medium + MTT + DMSO, no cells) in
column 10. Rows B–G = 6 technical replicate wells. One experiment, so n = wells.

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(emmeans)
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
```

```{r import}
mtt <- read_csv("data/mtt_raw.csv")
```

## Step 1: background

The background is the mean of the blank wells (medium + MTT + DMSO, no cells).

```{r blank}
blank <- mtt %>% filter(condition == "blank") %>% pull(od540) %>% mean()
blank
```

## Step 2: % of control

Subtract the blank from every well, then divide by the **mean** of the control wells.

```{r normalise}
wells <- mtt %>% filter(condition != "blank") %>%
  mutate(od_corr   = od540 - blank,
         viability = 100 * od_corr / mean(od_corr[p80_pct == 0]),
         dose      = factor(p80_pct),                    # "0" = control, the reference
         column    = as.integer(str_sub(well, 2)))       # plate column (2-10)
write_csv(wells, "results/mtt_per_well.csv")
```

**Plate check:** the two control columns (2 and 9) flank the series. A difference between them points to
a gradient across the plate (edge effect, pipetting order, temperature).

```{r control-columns}
wells %>% filter(p80_pct == 0) %>% mutate(side = factor(column)) %>%
  t_test(viability ~ side, detailed = TRUE)
```

## Step 3: describe

Mean ± SD of the wells per concentration (12 control wells).

```{r describe}
wells %>% group_by(p80_pct) %>%
  summarise(mean_viability = mean(viability), sd = sd(viability), n = n())
```

## Step 4: assumptions

Normality of the residuals and equal variances.

```{r assumptions}
fit <- aov(viability ~ dose, data = wells)
shapiro_test(residuals(fit))
wells %>% levene_test(viability ~ dose)
```

## Step 5: every concentration vs control

One-way ANOVA, then Dunnett: each concentration against the control.

```{r dunnett}
wells %>% anova_test(viability ~ dose)
emmeans(fit, trt.vs.ctrl ~ dose)$contrasts %>% summary(infer = TRUE)
```

When Levene says the SDs differ: Welch ANOVA + Games–Howell. As a rank-based check: Kruskal–Wallis +
Dunn vs control, Holm-adjusted over the 6 comparisons.

```{r unequal-sd}
wells %>% welch_anova_test(viability ~ dose)
wells %>% games_howell_test(viability ~ dose) %>% filter(group1 == "0")
wells %>% kruskal_test(viability ~ dose)
wells %>% dunn_test(viability ~ dose, p.adjust.method = "none") %>% filter(group1 == "0") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "holm")
```

## Step 6: dose-response curve and IC50

4-parameter log-logistic fit on all wells; the IC50 is the concentration that gives 50 % viability.

```{r ic50}
curve <- drc::drm(viability ~ p80_pct, data = wells, fct = drc::LL.4(
  names = c("Hill", "Bottom", "Top", "IC50")))
summary(curve)
ic50 <- drc::ED(curve, 50, type = "absolute", interval = "delta", display = FALSE)
ic50
```

## Plot

Dose response on a log axis; the control is drawn on the left as "0".

```{r plot}
x0   <- 0.0156                                          # plotting position of the control
pts  <- wells %>% mutate(x = if_else(p80_pct == 0, x0, p80_pct))
grid <- tibble(p80_pct = exp(seq(log(0.025), log(1.2), length.out = 200)))
grid$viability <- predict(curve, newdata = as.data.frame(grid))
p <- ggplot(pts, aes(x, viability)) +
  geom_line(data = grid, aes(p80_pct, viability), colour = "#BF0D3E", linewidth = 0.9) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1), geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.08, colour = "#333333") +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = p80_pct == 0), width = 0.03, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("point", x = ic50[1], y = 50, shape = 23, size = 3.5, fill = "white",
           colour = "#BF0D3E", stroke = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = ic50[1] * 1.15, y = 50, hjust = 0, colour = "#BF0D3E", size = 4.1,
           label = sprintf("IC50 = %.2f %%", ic50[1])) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#0028A5", `FALSE` = "#BF0D3E"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(x0, 0.03125, 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1),
                labels = c("0", "0.031", "0.063", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-5, 125), breaks = seq(0, 120, 20)) +
  labs(x = "P80 (% v/v, log scale)", y = "Viability (% of control)",
       caption = "Simulated data, points = wells (n = 6; control 12); mean \u00B1 SD; line = 4-parameter fit")
p
ggsave("figures/02_mtt_viability.png", p, width = 6.4, height = 4.2, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```
